# temps_feature_flag_environment (Resource)

A feature flag's value and kill switch in one environment. Destroying it removes the override, so the environment serves the flag default again with the switch on.

Import with `<project_id>/<key>/<environment_id>`.

Required API key permissions: `flags:read`, `flags:write`, `flags:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Turn the redesigned checkout on in staging only.
resource "temps_feature_flag_environment" "new_checkout_staging" {
  project_id     = temps_project.web.id
  key            = temps_feature_flag.new_checkout.key
  environment_id = temps_environment.staging.id
  value          = jsonencode(true)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (Number) ID of an environment of `project_id`.
- `key` (String) Key of the flag, usually `temps_feature_flag.<name>.key`.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Kill switch. `false` serves the flag default in this environment whatever `value` says. Defaults to `true`.
- `value` (String) JSON-encoded value for this environment, for example `jsonencode(true)`; it must match the flag's type. Omit it to serve the flag default.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<project_id>/<key>/<environment_id>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_feature_flag_environment.new_checkout_staging 3/new-checkout/5
```
